'''Rasoria Domanche''' was a [[Hunter of the Horn]] from [[Tear]]. 

== Appearance ==
She is stocky with blue eyes and yellow hair.

== Activities ==
She becomes part of the [[Queen's Guards]] in [[Caemlyn]] and made a personal bodyguard of [[Elayne Trakand]]. She is later promoted to under-lieutenant of the guards.

She is on guard when [[Zaida din Parede Blackwing]] barges in on Elayne in the bath. Elayne isn't impressed with either woman.
